title: Reinforcement Learning from Meta-Evaluation: Aligning Language Models Without Ground-Truth Labels

bias_targets.methodology: Extending RLME training beyond validation accuracy saturation and manually inspecting the generator's outputs to observe if it learns to exploit the evaluator model's tendency to endorse (answer "Yes" to) incorrect or formulaic reasoning.

Evaluating the model on the FaithEval-Counterfactual dataset, which provides contexts that conflict with the model's prior world knowledge, to measure whether the model remains faithful to the prompt or inappropriately relies on its pre-trained internal biases.
